turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Singh from Chennai?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is he. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Ananya from Global Task Solutions. I am calling regarding your application for the part-time home assistant role online.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Application? I do not remember applying for any such job, beta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It was likely through the WhatsApp portal you visited. You just need to like a few videos to earn daily commissions, very simple work for seniors.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I see. But how can I be sure this is genuine?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, your first bonus of five thousand is already waiting in your portal account. You just need to pay a security activation fee of nine thousand five hundred rupees to unlock it.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Nine thousand? That is a lot of money just to start a job.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is a refundable deposit, Mr. Singh. Once you complete the first five tasks today, you will get everything back with a huge profit.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am not sure. Can I talk to my son first?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The offer expires in ten minutes, sir. If you send the payment now via UPI, I will double your first commission immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, why is there such a hurry?
